reviewMethod: Root actually read all12 complete POS/meanings/forms/ENZH rows and all proposed full retained tuples; consulted primary publisher and university references. No copied publisher example sentences.

decisions.reason: Transitive legal withholding, not food decoration. Passive future wages, part rather than all, notice and debt purpose are faithfully preserved. Merriam-Webster confirms the separate legal role. The sentence is fictional and asserts no jurisdiction-specific procedure.

Informal countable money noun, 1000 dollars or pounds, unchanged plural grand. US$4000 establishes dollars; one grand over budget is exactly 1000 above the budget. No adjective inflections are borrowed.

Purpose-specific adjective modifies notebook; not the devoted-person adjective or an automatic form of dedicate. Chinese retains dedicated notebook, heard words and bus. Empty declared forms prevent automatic past-verb expansion.

Degree adverb modifying lower costs. EN and ZH both explicitly place the move nearer work before the reduction; no statistical significance claim or unsupported distance detail. Old essentially/mainly sense remains separate.

Adjective describes a sudden adverse sales decline, not a physical cliff or rash action. Closing the bridge precedes falling sales in both languages. Keep the old rash-action gloss only with its attested usage caveat.

Officially require, transitive verb with a noun object review. Chinese retains court, required review, company and payment records. It is not the historical administer-territory role or the noun command.

Predicative adjective phrase means responsible for an error. Sending invitations to the wrong address is accurately attributed to the speaker. The old perplexed/faulty whole tuple is NOT approved for active retention: a machine causing trouble is not simply equivalent to every machine having a fault.

Uncountable act of supplying, with provision of meals to residents, distinct from supplies, preparation and contractual terms. Chinese retains the council plan, hot meals and older residents; no inserted outcome claim.

Plural school former attendees/graduates; modern mixed-gender groups are permitted, as the primary university style guide confirms. Several generations returning for an exhibition is naturally translated as multiple cohorts. Traditional male plural remains a scoped alternative.

Noun for the routine option absent a different agreement; not debt nonpayment. The shared desk and advance agreement for a separate room are preserved. Old computing and failure senses remain separate.

Bargain is negotiate, with for marking the sought condition; this is not anticipate/bargain on. Tenants negotiate for a longer notice period before signing; EN/ZH preserve parties, order and sought condition. Phrasal-pattern forms preserve tense.

Informal idiom for sudden substantial financial success. The example describes hope at launch, not an accomplished profit or guaranteed outcome. Chinese preserves first game and the wish to become rich; old mineral-deposit role is scoped to financial success.
